tonight.headline: Irving put 31.5 on you last night; nothing of yours has moved since Thursday
body: Bad news first. You are 0–4 and already 31.5 behind: Bucky Irving ran 21 times for 165 yards and scored twice for Los Gigantes de Teca last night. ESPN now has you at 44%, 122.1 against 133.8. McLaurin has still not practised since 2 Oct and Monangai has not practised this week.

Nothing about your own players is newer than Thursday afternoon. Friday's practice reports come out this afternoon and they decide all three cards: McLaurin for the flex, Jefferson's status, and whether Likely needs a replacement. Nothing needs doing this morning.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Irving's 31.5 is banked: 21 carries for 165, a rushing touchdown and a receiving one (archive; Buccaneers.com, 9 Oct). Ja'Marr Chase, their top projection at 21.9, was limited on Thursday and still in the concussion protocol; the Miami Herald's Omar Kelly wrote that if he practises on Friday he will likely be cleared (via Yahoo, 8 Oct 18:54 ET). Chuba Hubbard is still in their flex on a bye at 0.0, with Rome Odunze, 10.9, on their bench, so their number rises again when they fix it. McBride 18.8, Purdy 18.0, London 16.0.

case.label: Your side
case.body: As set: Allen 20.1, Jefferson 18.6, Wilson 14.8, Warren 14.5, Tuten 14.0, Likely 12.9, Gordon 10.9, Fairbairn 8.5, the Vikings 7.8. Jefferson and Likely are questionable and both practised, limited, on Wednesday and Thursday. None of the nine has played.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Friday's reports. Jefferson or Likely missing practice, on your side; Chase clearing the protocol, on theirs. McLaurin practising turns the flex back into a 2.3-point swap.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · fire it only if he practises this afternoon · both kick off Sun 11:00 Mexico City · inactives 09:30
doFirst.title: Flex: leave Gordon. McLaurin only if he practises today
doFirst.subtitle: 13.2 against 10.9 on paper. He missed Wednesday and Thursday and was not at warmups; Friday's session, this afternoon, is his last. ESPN's number shows none of it.

case.label: What the check says
case.body: As set you project 122.1; the projection lineup is 124.4. The whole 2.3 is McLaurin over Gordon in the flex, which the tool labels PROJECTION. It is the only difference.

case.label: Why it is not set
case.body: The Washington Post's Tashan Reed on Thursday: 'Terry McLaurin (hamstring) isn't out here during warmups.' The official report has him out of practice on Wednesday and Thursday (commanders.com). He has not practised since the hamstring on 2 Oct. Both absences came after ESPN's 13.2 and run against it, which is the one kind of news that overrides a projection. Nothing newer was found this morning and no Dan Quinn quote exists for either day.

case.label: New since Thursday
case.body: Only about the men around him. Stefon Diggs was listed as not practising but 'was working off to the side after warmups' (Reed, via Heavy on Yahoo, Thu 22:46 ET), so he is ahead of McLaurin. Jayden Daniels is 'full go' in an elbow brace (ESPN's John Keim via Heavy, 8 Oct), so the quarterback is the right one if McLaurin does play.

case.label: The order if he sits
case.body: Gordon, 10.9, keeps the slot. Kamara, 11.2, is a 0.3 coin flip with him and still questionable; nothing is written down for that one. All three play at 11:00 on Sunday.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: McLaurin starts in your flex and Gordon outscores him on Sunday (archive). If McLaurin does not practise or is inactive, the swap never happens and the entry closes untested.

case.body: Limited on Wednesday and Thursday with the ankle (vikings.com, 8 Oct 16:30). He told The Athletic's Alec Lewis that playing is 'definitely the plan' (via Athlon, 8 Oct). Kevin O'Connell has not said so; ClutchPoints on Thursday night still called his Sunday status uncertain. vikings.com: game status designations come on Friday.

case.label: The fallback
case.body: Addison was limited on Thursday after sitting out Wednesday with the hamstring (vikings.com). He projects 11.4. If Jefferson is inactive Addison takes the receiver slot; Kamara is the next option if Addison is scratched too.

case.label: Why this is unarmed
case.body: The lineup is right as it stands, 18.6 against 11.4. Both play in the same game at 11:00, so the swap can wait for the inactive list at 09:30 on Sunday. That list is not out on any Sunday morning brief written at 07:00; check it yourself.

case.body: Jefferson is active and Addison outscores him on Sunday (archive). If Jefferson is inactive this card fires and the open lineup thesis closes untested.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · decide on this afternoon's report · Juwan Johnson kicks off Sun 11:00 Mexico City, with Likely
doFirst.title: If Likely is ruled out: add Juwan Johnson, free
doFirst.subtitle: Likely was limited Wednesday and Thursday with a knee and groin nobody has explained. You still have nobody behind him. Johnson is still a free agent this morning. Do nothing until Friday's report.

case.label: The hole
case.body: The lineup check prints it plainly: nobody eligible on the bench. The listing is four days old and still has no cause (Big Blue Interactive, 8 Oct 19:19 ET; giants.com's tracker has nothing after 16:00 Thursday). Thursday's brief leaned on a team-site writer seeing no danger to Sunday; this morning's research could not find that remark again, so do not lean on it. ESPN still projects 12.9.

case.label: Who is there
case.body: Juwan Johnson, 10.1, is still a free agent in this snapshot: targets 4, 8, 8 in the last three weeks (archive), not on the Saints' report, and his quarterback practised in full on both days. He kicks off at 11:00 on Sunday, the same hour as Likely, so he can be added after the 09:30 inactive list. Dallas Goedert projects 10.9 but was limited again with a knee and locks at 07:30 in London, as does Brenton Strange, 9.7. Mark Andrews, 9.6, has a quarterback who has not practised this week.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Addison, if Jefferson is active: he is 7.2 under Jefferson and off in Week 6. If Jefferson's own status is in doubt, Addison is needed, and the seat is Monangai's if he is ruled out with the turf toe, or Coker's if he is not. Kamara and Gordon each have an injured teammate and cannot be named.

case.label: Why not add him today
case.body: He is free, so a rival can take him at any moment. Against that, the strategy says not to carry a second tight end in a league whose flex cannot use one, and Likely has practised twice. It is a risk I am choosing, for one more report.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Likely is ruled out and Johnson, Goedert, Strange and Andrews are all gone by then (the wait cost the slot). Or, if it fires, the tight end added scores less than the player dropped for him would have (archive). If Likely plays, this card never fires.

whatWentWrong.title: McLaurin: eight days without a practice
whatWentWrong.lead: Hurt on 2 Oct, inactive in Week 4, absent Wednesday and Thursday and not at warmups. ESPN still projects 13.2 as if he plays.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Tashan Reed, Thursday: 'Terry McLaurin (hamstring) isn't out here during warmups.' commanders.com lists him out of both sessions. Diggs, the other starter, at least worked on the side. No coach has spoken about either.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The first card stays unarmed. The projection lineup wants him in the flex by 2.3; two missed practices say leave Gordon. This afternoon's session is the only one left.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A practice of any kind on Friday. Then the swap is a plain projection call and should be made, with Gordon as the fallback at 09:30 on Sunday.

whatWentWrong.sources: Tashan Reed via Heavy/Yahoo · commanders.com · lineup_check.py

whatWentWrong.title: Monangai's 'rest day' is turf toe, and nothing has improved
whatWentWrong.lead: No practice on Wednesday or Thursday. Fowler's report stands and no Bears coach has spoken since.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Out of both practices with a thumb and toe listing (packers.com). Jeremy Fowler: 'dealing with a turf toe injury, placing uncertainty around his availability over the next 1-2 weeks' (via Roundtable Sports on Yahoo, Thu 22:56 ET). On Wednesday Ben Johnson had said: 'The thumb is not an issue, but he did have 30 carries, and he feels like he had 30 carries.' D'Andre Swift was limited on Thursday after sitting out Wednesday.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: He was already on your bench by projection, so no lineup move. It changes the third card's drop: if he is ruled out today, his is the seat a tight end would take, ahead of Coker's.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A practice this afternoon and an active tag on Sunday, with Swift's hip still limiting him.

worthALook.name: Juwan Johnson
worthALook.lead: Still a free agent this morning: the fallback tight end, because he kicks off with Likely.

case.label: The role
case.body: Targets 4, 8, 8 in the last three weeks for 10.6, 23.3 and 11.9 (archive). Not on the Saints' report; Tyler Shough practised in full on Wednesday and Thursday.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 10.1 against Likely's 12.9, with nowhere to play a second tight end. Minnesota's defence was ranked second for the week by NBC Sports on 6 Oct.

case.label: When to act
case.body: This afternoon if Likely is ruled out or does not practise; otherwise Sunday 09:30, and only if Likely is inactive. If a rival adds him first, Goedert, Strange and Andrews remain, each with an earlier lock or a quarterback problem.

worthALook.sources: Week 2–4 archive · vikings.com's copy of the Saints' report · ESPN league file

worthALook.name: Brenton Strange
worthALook.lead: A real role, and no use to you unless Likely sits. He locks at 07:30 on Sunday, before Likely's inactive list.

case.label: The role
case.body: 7 catches on 8 targets for 95 in Week 4 (archive) with every Jacksonville pass-catcher playing, so no injury explains it. Targets 3, 2, 5, 8. He is not on Jacksonville's report.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: One tight-end slot, an RB/WR-only flex, and Likely projects 3.2 higher. Philadelphia allow the fifth-fewest points to tight ends (FootballDB, PPR, re-read Fri 9 Oct).

case.label: When to act
case.body: Only if Likely is ruled out by Saturday. If the decision goes to Sunday's inactive list, Strange has already kicked off and Juwan Johnson is the one.

worthALook.name: Rico Dowdle
worthALook.lead: The back who takes carries from your Warren when he returns. Limited twice, and a coin toss for Sunday.

case.label: The role
case.body: Limited on Wednesday and Thursday with the toe (Steelers Depot, 8 Oct). McCarthy: status up in the air, and a platoon once he is healthy (RotoWire, a paraphrase); Colts On SI calls him a coin toss. With him active Warren took 56% and 55% of the carries; without him, all of them (archive).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: A handcuff to a back you start, on a roster with five backs and no free seat. He ran 15 times for 37 yards before the injury (archive).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing makes him an add here. A full practice this afternoon matters for Warren's number, not for your roster.

worthALook.sources: Steelers Depot · RotoWire · Colts On SI · Week 1–4 archive

doNotChase.name: Jacoby Brissett
doNotChase.lead: The biggest riser on your wire this morning. The reason is the opponent, and you start Josh Allen.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Arizona are at home to Detroit, who have allowed the most points to quarterbacks, the second-most to receivers and the most to tight ends through Week 4 (FootballDB, PPR). SportsGrid's waiver column picked him out for it on 6 Oct. He is not on Arizona's injury report.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 19.0 against Allen's 20.1, in a league that starts one quarterback. His Week 4 line was 21 of 35 for 166 with two touchdowns and three interceptions (SportsGrid).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Allen appearing on a Bills injury report before Monday. Nothing else.

doNotChase.sources: FootballDB · SportsGrid · azcardinals.com · ESPN league file

doNotChase.name: Will Shipley
doNotChase.lead: Still rising. Barkley has not practised and is trending out; no coach has said how the work splits.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Saquon Barkley missed Wednesday and Thursday and PhillyVoice's Jimmy Kempski expects him not to practise or play (via Heavy, 9 Oct 06:01 ET; a beat writer's view, with no team status yet). Tank Bigsby is on injured reserve. Outlets expect Shipley to start.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: No coach has described a split, Dameon Pierce is on the 53, and one report has Philadelphia possibly elevating Carson Steele (ClutchPoints, 7 Oct). 6 carries for 23 last week and 15 all season (archive). 10.2 is below all five of your backs.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Barkley ruled out for a month, and one of your own backs ruled out with him.

doNotChase.sources: philadelphiaeagles.com · Heavy citing PhillyVoice · ClutchPoints · Week 1–4 archive

doNotChase.name: Jaguars D/ST
doNotChase.lead: The fastest-rising free defence, 0.2 above yours.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Philadelphia in London without Barkley, DeVonta Smith or Hollywood Brown at practice all week, and with Dontayvion Wicks limited by a hamstring he hurt on Thursday. NBC Sports ranked Jacksonville first for the week on 6 Oct.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 8.0 against the Vikings' 7.8. Under a point is not a streaming move. Three Jacksonville corners were limited again on Thursday, and they are off in Week 7.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing this week. Next Tuesday you need a defence for Minnesota's bye, and that is when this row is read again.

doNotChase.sources: ESPN league file · philadelphiaeagles.com · NBC Sports

doNotChase.name: Roman Wilson
doNotChase.lead: Rising because Pittman is out for weeks. His targets did not move the last time that happened.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Michael Pittman Jr. re-injured his foot and will miss 'multiple weeks' (McCarthy via Steelers Depot, 8 Oct). When Pittman sat in Week 2, Wilson was the second receiver beside DK Metcalf on 55 of 70 snaps (The Fantasy Footballers). Nothing overnight names Pittman's replacement.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Six targets in every one of his four games, the Week 2 game without Pittman included (archive). He shared those second-receiver snaps with the rookie Germie Bernard. 10.3, below McLaurin and Addison on your bench.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Eight or more targets against Indianapolis. He is a free agent, so it costs nothing to look again on Tuesday.

doNotChase.sources: Steelers Depot · The Fantasy Footballers · Week 1–4 archive

case.label: What would change it

waiverAnalysis.summary: The same four receivers clear the tool's bar as on Thursday, and the bar is still partly an artefact: it measures them against Coker, whose last two weeks are an injury and a missed game. Four weeks of data. Nothing overnight turned a role reason into a move, and no receiver seat is open. Nothing clears at running back or tight end.

Brown is with New England and walking without a limp, with no return date verified.
rising.action: WATCH — the role probably lasts one more game; no receiver seat is open

rising.action: WATCH — a real role at 7.6 points a game, and no receiver seat is open
rising.sources: clevelandbrowns.com · Dawgs By Nature via Yahoo · Week 1–4 archive
